definition: טֹ֫רַח noun masculine budren , figurative הָיוּ עָלַי לָטֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵיתִי נְשׂא׃ Isa 1:14 they are become a burden on me, I am weary of bearing ; אֵיכָה אֶשָּׂא טָרְחֲכֶם Deut 1:12 (+ מַשַּׂאֲכֶם וְרֵיבְכֶם ) how can I bear the burden of you ?
